shortDescription: Malaysia charged senior United Malays National Organisation politician Abdul Azeez Abdul Rahim with graft over the management of the country’s Muslim pilgrimage fund, according to Bloomberg.The case adds to tensions within Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s multi-coalition ruling alliance.

title: Malaysia Charges UMNO Politician Abdul Azeez Abdul Rahim With Graft Over Pilgrimage Fund
